description.value:
Frequency once per day

Cost 4 Vitae

Range 60 feet

Area 30-foot burst

Saving Throw basic Fortitude

One throw. The wind does the rest, and the wind is not on anyone's side.

Every creature in the area takes @Damage[12d6[untyped]] damage of your thrown Graft’s type and, on a failure, suffers that Graft’s non-damaging effect as well. Allies in the area take nothing.

cinderfall.incomplete: This feat's damage type is whichever Graft consumable you threw to trigger it, which Foundry can't reference dynamically; the inline @Damage token defaults to untyped so a die roll still fires -- set the correct type manually at the table based on which Graft was used.
